items.title: Run CUDA apps on AMD Windows
items.oneliner: Reproducible ZLUDA setup runs CUDA workloads on AMD GPUs in Windows, including LibTorch training tests.

items.title: Visualize slow builds on Linux
items.oneliner: CLI tracer wraps any build command and exposes compile bottlenecks, parallelism gaps, and redundant work on a timeline.

items.title: Bridge classic Macs to modern networks
items.oneliner: Rust userspace AppleTalk stack shares files, printers, and disk images with vintage Macs over modern networks.

items.title: Embed Rust inside Python libraries
items.oneliner: Hands-on PyO3 tutorial shows how to compile a Rust JSON parser into a Python importable extension.

items.title: Make your first OpenStreetMap edit
items.oneliner: Step-by-step JOSM walkthrough helps you add website metadata to real places and ship a useful map contribution.

items.title: Use agents beyond code generation
items.oneliner: Practical prompt guide shows agents fixing merge conflicts, triaging issues, and automating repetitive developer workflows.

items.title: Inspect browser fingerprinting locally
items.oneliner: Interactive demo reveals what a webpage can infer about your device and session without sending data off-browser.

items.title: Block macOS updates indefinitely
items.oneliner: Terminal commands disable macOS update prompts by changing MobileAsset endpoints, with exact rollback steps included.

items.title: Explore a tiny Lisp for Uxn
items.oneliner: Experimental 16-bit Lisp for the Uxn VM includes lambdas, recursion, and list primitives for constrained systems.

items.title: Use the xkcd font in projects
items.oneliner: Cloneable font repo includes prebuilt xkcd typefaces and previews for adding comic-style text to apps or docs.
